CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.fn_plural_ru(p_n BIGINT, p_one TEXT, p_few TEXT, p_many TEXT) RETURNS TEXT LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN (p_n % 100) BETWEEN 11 AND 14 THEN p_many
        WHEN (p_n % 10) = 1 THEN p_one
        WHEN (p_n % 10) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN p_few
        ELSE p_many
    END;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_analytics_charts_breakdown(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_source VARCHAR, p_days INT DEFAULT 7, p_theme_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)) RETURNS TABLE (label VARCHAR, value DECIMAL) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    v_days INTEGER := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days, 7), 90));
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);

    IF p_source NOT IN ('qr', 'tasks', 'goods', 'all') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SOURCE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF p_source = 'qr' THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            ol.snapshot_package_name::VARCHAR AS label,
            count(*)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_commerce.order_lines ol
        JOIN qr_commerce.orders o ON o.id = ol.order_id
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
        WHERE os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND o.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY ol.snapshot_package_name
        ORDER BY count(*) DESC, ol.snapshot_package_name;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF p_source = 'tasks' THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            sc.name::VARCHAR AS label,
            count(*)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT p2.paid_at
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments p2
            JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p2.status_id
            WHERE p2.service_task_id = st.id
              AND ps.code = 'succeeded'
            ORDER BY p2.paid_at DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1
        ) p ON TRUE
        WHERE p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND (p_theme_code IS NULL OR sc.code = p_theme_code)
          AND p.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY sc.name
        ORDER BY count(*) DESC, sc.name;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    IF p_source = 'goods' THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT
            ol.kind::VARCHAR AS label,
            sum(ol.line_total_rub)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = so.status_id
        JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = so.id
        WHERE os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND so.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND so.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY ol.kind
        ORDER BY sum(ol.line_total_rub) DESC, ol.kind;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- all sources: pie by revenue
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH src AS (
        SELECT 'QR'::VARCHAR AS label,
               sum(o.total_amount)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_commerce.orders o
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
        WHERE os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND o.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'Задания'::VARCHAR AS label,
               sum(coalesce(p.amount_rub, st.final_amount_rub, st.desired_amount_rub))::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT p2.amount_rub, p2.paid_at
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments p2
            JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p2.status_id
            WHERE p2.service_task_id = st.id
              AND ps.code = 'succeeded'
            ORDER BY p2.paid_at DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1
        ) p ON TRUE
        WHERE p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND (p_theme_code IS NULL OR sc.code = p_theme_code)
          AND p.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'Размещение (50 ₽)'::VARCHAR AS label,
               sum(cp.amount_rub)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_product_listing_payments cp
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = cp.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND cp.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'Покупки в шопе'::VARCHAR AS label,
               sum(so.total_rub)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS value
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = so.status_id
        WHERE os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND so.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND so.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
    )
    SELECT src.label,
           coalesce(src.value, 0::NUMERIC(12,2)) AS value
    FROM src
    WHERE coalesce(src.value, 0::NUMERIC(12,2)) > 0
    ORDER BY value DESC, label;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_analytics_charts_daily(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_source VARCHAR, p_days INT DEFAULT 7, p_theme_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)) RETURNS TABLE (day DATE, revenue_rub DECIMAL, units BIGINT) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    v_days INTEGER := greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_days, 7), 90));
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);

    IF p_source NOT IN ('qr', 'tasks', 'goods', 'all') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_SOURCE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH days AS (
        SELECT (current_date - (g.i || ' days')::INTERVAL)::DATE AS day
        FROM generate_series(v_days - 1, 0, -1) AS g(i)
    ),
    src AS (
        -- QR orders
        SELECT (o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE AS day,
               sum(o.total_amount)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS revenue_rub,
               count(*)::BIGINT AS units
        FROM qr_commerce.orders o
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
        WHERE (p_source = 'qr' OR p_source = 'all')
          AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND o.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY 1

        UNION ALL

        -- Оплаченные задания (успешная оплата)
        SELECT (p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE AS day,
               sum(coalesce(p.amount_rub, st.final_amount_rub, st.desired_amount_rub))::NUMERIC(12,2) AS revenue_rub,
               count(*)::BIGINT AS units
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT p2.amount_rub, p2.paid_at
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments p2
            JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p2.status_id
            WHERE p2.service_task_id = st.id
              AND ps.code = 'succeeded'
            ORDER BY p2.paid_at DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1
        ) p ON TRUE
        WHERE (p_source = 'tasks' OR p_source = 'all')
          AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND (p_theme_code IS NULL OR sc.code = p_theme_code)
          AND p.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY 1

        UNION ALL

        -- Покупки в шопе компаний
        SELECT (so.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE AS day,
               sum(so.total_rub)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS revenue_rub,
               coalesce(sum(ol.quantity), 0)::BIGINT AS units
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so
        JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = so.status_id
        LEFT JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = so.id
        WHERE (p_source = 'goods' OR p_source = 'all')
          AND so.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND os.code IN ('paid', 'fulfilled')
          AND so.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY 1

        UNION ALL

        -- Размещение товаров на витрине (50₽) — только в «все покупки»
        SELECT (cp.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::DATE AS day,
               sum(cp.amount_rub)::NUMERIC(12,2) AS revenue_rub,
               sum(cp.product_count)::BIGINT AS units
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_product_listing_payments cp
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = cp.status_id
        WHERE (p_source = 'all')
          AND cp.paid_at IS NOT NULL
          AND ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND cp.paid_at >= ((current_date - ((v_days - 1) || ' days')::INTERVAL) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')
        GROUP BY 1
    )
    SELECT d.day,
           coalesce(sum(src.revenue_rub), 0::NUMERIC(12,2)) AS revenue_rub,
           -- sum(bigint) → numeric в PG; OUT units — bigint
           coalesce(sum(src.units), 0)::BIGINT AS units
    FROM days d
    LEFT JOIN src ON src.day = d.day
    GROUP BY d.day
    ORDER BY d.day;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_finance_parties(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_movement_id TEXT) RETURNS JSONB LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_kind TEXT;
    v_id TEXT;
    v_customer UUID;
    v_executor UUID;
    v_company UUID;
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);
    v_kind := split_part(coalesce(p_movement_id, ''), ':', 1);
    v_id := split_part(coalesce(p_movement_id, ''), ':', 2);
    IF v_id !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'MOVEMENT_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    IF v_kind = 'payout' THEN
        SELECT st.customer_user_id, ep.company_id
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_marketplace.executor_payouts ep
        JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = ep.service_task_id
        WHERE ep.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'taskpay' THEN
        SELECT st.customer_user_id, st.assigned_company_id
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments tp
        JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = tp.service_task_id
        WHERE tp.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'wallet' THEN
        SELECT wt.user_id,
               CASE WHEN wt.reference_type = 'service_task' THEN (
                   SELECT st.assigned_company_id
                   FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
                   WHERE st.id = wt.reference_id
               ) ELSE NULL END
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        WHERE wt.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'goods' THEN
        SELECT so.buyer_user_id, so.company_id
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_payments pay
        JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so ON so.id = pay.order_id
        WHERE pay.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'topup' THEN
        SELECT p.user_id INTO v_customer
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_top_up_payments p
        WHERE p.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'memorial' THEN
        SELECT o.user_id INTO v_customer
        FROM qr_commerce.payments pay
        JOIN qr_commerce.orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id
        WHERE pay.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'listing' THEN
        SELECT lp.paid_by_user_id, lp.company_id
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_product_listing_payments lp
        WHERE lp.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'referral' THEN
        SELECT rc.referred_user_id, rc.company_id
        INTO v_customer, v_company
        FROM qr_marketplace.referral_commissions rc
        WHERE rc.id = v_id::uuid;
    ELSE
        SELECT u.id INTO v_customer
        FROM qr_identity.users u
        WHERE u.id = v_id::uuid AND u.deleted_at IS NULL;
    END IF;

    IF v_company IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT cm.user_id INTO v_executor
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
        WHERE cm.company_id = v_company
        ORDER BY cm.is_primary_contact DESC, cm.invited_at
        LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    IF v_customer IS NULL AND v_executor IS NULL AND v_company IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'MOVEMENT_NOT_FOUND';
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'customer', CASE WHEN v_customer IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
            SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                'user_id', u.id,
                'name', u.full_name,
                'email', u.email,
                'phone', u.phone,
                'payout', (
                    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                        'recipient_name', d.recipient_name,
                        'bank_name', d.bank_name,
                        'bik', d.bik,
                        'correspondent_account', d.correspondent_account,
                        'settlement_account', d.settlement_account
                    )
                    FROM qr_identity.user_payout_details d
                    WHERE d.user_id = u.id
                )
            )
            FROM qr_identity.users u WHERE u.id = v_customer
        ) END,
        'executor', CASE WHEN v_company IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
            SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                'user_id', u.id,
                'name', coalesce(u.full_name, c.legal_name),
                'email', u.email,
                'phone', u.phone,
                'company_name', c.legal_name,
                'bank', (
                    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                        'bank_name', bd.bank_name,
                        'bik', bd.bik,
                        'correspondent_account', bd.correspondent_account,
                        'settlement_account', bd.settlement_account
                    )
                    FROM qr_marketplace.company_bank_details bd
                    WHERE bd.company_id = c.id
                    ORDER BY bd.is_primary DESC, bd.created_at
                    LIMIT 1
                )
            )
            FROM qr_marketplace.companies c
            LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = v_executor
            WHERE c.id = v_company
        ) END
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_get_order(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_order_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, order_number BIGINT, status_code VARCHAR, status_name VARCHAR, package_name VARCHAR, quantity INT, total_amount DECIMAL, shipment_count INT, delivered_quantity INT, buyer_name VARCHAR, buyer_email VARCHAR, buyer_phone VARCHAR, qr_count INT, qr_assigned_count INT, plaque_fulfillment_mode VARCHAR, paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        o.id,
        o.order_number,
        os.code,
        os.name,
        ol.snapshot_package_name,
        ol.quantity,
        o.total_amount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM qr_commerce.order_deliveries od WHERE od.order_id = o.id),
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(od.quantity), 0)::INTEGER
         FROM qr_commerce.order_deliveries od
         JOIN qr_ref.fulfillment_statuses fs ON fs.id = od.fulfillment_status_id
         WHERE od.order_id = o.id AND fs.code IN ('delivered', 'self_print', 'completed')),
        o.buyer_name,
        o.buyer_email::VARCHAR,
        o.buyer_phone,
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q WHERE q.order_id = o.id),
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q WHERE q.order_id = o.id AND q.memorial_id IS NOT NULL),
        o.plaque_fulfillment_mode,
        o.paid_at,
        o.created_at

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_list_finance_movements(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_status_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_user_id UUID DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS UUID), p_query VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_limit INT DEFAULT 50, p_offset INT DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE (movement_id TEXT, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ, user_id UUID, user_name TEXT, user_email TEXT, direction TEXT, kind TEXT, status_code TEXT, title TEXT, amount_rub DECIMAL, reference_label TEXT, total_count BIGINT) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_status TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_status_code, '')), '');
    v_query TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);
    IF v_status = 'all' THEN
        v_status := NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH mov AS (
        SELECT
            ('wallet:' || wt.id::text) AS movement_id,
            wt.created_at AS occurred_at,
            wt.user_id,
            u.full_name::text AS user_name,
            u.email::text AS user_email,
            CASE
                WHEN wt.type IN ('top_up', 'task_cancel_refund', 'bid_refund', 'work_refund', 'admin_refund', 'shop_refund')
                    THEN 'in'
                ELSE 'out'
            END AS direction,
            CASE wt.type
                WHEN 'top_up' THEN 'top_up'
                WHEN 'work_payment' THEN 'task_work'
                WHEN 'task_publish_fee' THEN 'task_fee'
                WHEN 'bid_fee' THEN 'executor_fee'
                WHEN 'listing_fee' THEN 'listing'
                WHEN 'package_upgrade' THEN 'package'
                WHEN 'task_cancel_refund' THEN 'refund'
                WHEN 'bid_refund' THEN 'refund'
                WHEN 'work_refund' THEN 'refund'
                WHEN 'admin_refund' THEN 'refund'
                WHEN 'admin_debit' THEN 'admin'
                WHEN 'shop_payment' THEN 'shop'
                WHEN 'shop_refund' THEN 'shop_refund'
                ELSE wt.type
            END AS kind,
            CASE
                WHEN wt.type IN ('task_cancel_refund', 'bid_refund', 'work_refund', 'admin_refund', 'shop_refund')
                    THEN 'refund'
                ELSE 'succeeded'
            END AS status_code,
            coalesce(wt.description, wt.type)::text AS title,
            abs(wt.amount)::numeric AS amount_rub,
            CASE
                WHEN wt.reference_type = 'service_task' THEN
                    (SELECT 'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
                     FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st WHERE st.id = wt.reference_id)
                WHEN wt.reference_type = 'bid' THEN
                    (SELECT 'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
                     FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b
                     JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = b.service_task_id
                     WHERE b.id = wt.reference_id)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS reference_label
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = wt.user_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('topup:' || p.id::text),
            p.created_at,
            p.user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'in',
            'top_up',
            CASE WHEN ps.code IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'pending' END,
            'Пополнение кошелька',
            p.amount_rub::numeric,
            NULL
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_top_up_payments p
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = p.user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        WHERE ps.code <> 'succeeded'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('memorial:' || pay.id::text),
            pay.created_at,
            o.user_id,
            coalesce(u.full_name, o.buyer_name)::text,
            coalesce(u.email::text, o.buyer_email::text),
            'in',
            'memorial',
            CASE
                WHEN ps.code = 'succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN ps.code IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            'Оплата QR-мемориала',
            pay.amount_rub,
            'Заказ №' || o.order_number::text
        FROM qr_commerce.payments pay
        JOIN qr_commerce.orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id
        LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = pay.status_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('goods:' || pay.id::text),
            pay.created_at,
            so.buyer_user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'in',
            'goods',
            CASE
                WHEN ps.code = 'succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN ps.code IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            'Оплата товаров',
            pay.amount_rub,
            'Сделка №' || so.order_number::text
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_payments pay
        JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so ON so.id = pay.order_id
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = so.buyer_user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = pay.status_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('listing:' || lp.id::text),
            lp.created_at,
            lp.paid_by_user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'in',
            'listing',
            CASE
                WHEN ps.code = 'succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN ps.code IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            'Оплата размещения на витрине',
            lp.amount_rub,
            NULL
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_product_listing_payments lp
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = lp.paid_by_user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = lp.status_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('taskpay:' || tp.id::text),
            tp.created_at,
            st.customer_user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'in',
            'task_work',
            CASE
                WHEN ps.code = 'succeeded' THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN ps.code IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            'Оплата задания через ЮKassa',
            tp.amount_rub,
            'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments tp
        JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = tp.service_task_id
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = st.customer_user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = tp.status_id
        WHERE tp.provider IS DISTINCT FROM 'wallet'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('payout:' || ep.id::text),
            coalesce(ep.paid_at, ep.created_at),
            cm.user_id,
            coalesce(eu.full_name, c.legal_name)::text,
            eu.email::text,
            'out',
            'payout',
            CASE
                WHEN pst.code = 'paid' THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN pst.code = 'failed' THEN 'cancelled'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            'Выплата исполнителю',
            ep.amount_rub,
            'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
        FROM qr_marketplace.executor_payouts ep
        JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = ep.service_task_id
        JOIN qr_marketplace.companies c ON c.id = ep.company_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payout_statuses pst ON pst.id = ep.status_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT cm.user_id
            FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = c.id
            ORDER BY cm.is_primary_contact DESC, cm.invited_at
            LIMIT 1
        ) cm ON TRUE
        LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users eu ON eu.id = cm.user_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('referral:' || rc.id::text),
            rc.created_at,
            cm.user_id,
            coalesce(eu.full_name, c.legal_name)::text,
            eu.email::text,
            'in',
            'referral',
            'succeeded',
            'Реферальное начисление',
            rc.commission_rub,
            CASE
                WHEN rc.source_type = 'qr_order' THEN 'Заказ QR'
                ELSE 'Сделка витрины'
            END
        FROM qr_marketplace.referral_commissions rc
        JOIN qr_marketplace.companies c ON c.id = rc.company_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT cm.user_id
            FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = c.id
            ORDER BY cm.is_primary_contact DESC, cm.invited_at
            LIMIT 1
        ) cm ON TRUE
        LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users eu ON eu.id = cm.user_id
    ),
    filtered AS (
        SELECT * FROM mov m
        WHERE (p_user_id IS NULL OR m.user_id = p_user_id)
          AND (
                v_query IS NULL
                OR coalesce(m.user_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(m.user_email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(m.reference_label, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
              )
          AND (v_status IS NULL OR m.status_code = v_status)
    )
    SELECT
        f.movement_id,
        f.occurred_at,
        f.user_id,
        f.user_name,
        f.user_email,
        f.direction,
        f.kind,
        f.status_code,
        f.title,
        f.amount_rub,
        f.reference_label,
        count(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM filtered f
    ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC
    LIMIT greatest(p_limit, 1)
    OFFSET greatest(p_offset, 0);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_list_fiscal_receipt_slots(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_user_id UUID DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS UUID), p_query VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_limit INT DEFAULT 50, p_offset INT DEFAULT 0, p_status_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)) RETURNS TABLE (slot_id TEXT, occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ, user_id UUID, user_name TEXT, user_email TEXT, receipt_kind TEXT, title TEXT, amount_rub DECIMAL, reference_label TEXT, status_code TEXT, total_count BIGINT) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_query TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
    v_status TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_status_code, '')), '');
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);
    IF v_status = 'all' THEN
        v_status := NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH slots AS (
        SELECT
            ('adv:' || wt.id::text) AS slot_id,
            wt.created_at AS occurred_at,
            wt.user_id,
            u.full_name::text AS user_name,
            u.email::text AS user_email,
            'advance' AS receipt_kind,
            'Чек за аванс (пополнение)' AS title,
            abs(wt.amount)::numeric AS amount_rub,
            NULL::text AS reference_label
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = wt.user_id
        WHERE wt.type = 'top_up'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('fee:' || wt.id::text),
            wt.created_at,
            wt.user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'commission',
            'Чек за комиссию сайта',
            abs(wt.amount)::numeric,
            CASE
                WHEN wt.type = 'bid_fee' THEN (
                    SELECT 'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
                    FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b
                    JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = b.service_task_id
                    WHERE b.id = wt.reference_id
                )
                ELSE (
                    SELECT 'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
                    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st WHERE st.id = wt.reference_id
                )
            END
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = wt.user_id
        WHERE wt.type IN ('task_publish_fee', 'bid_fee')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('work:' || wt.id::text),
            wt.created_at,
            wt.user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'task_payment',
            'Чек за оплату задания',
            abs(wt.amount)::numeric,
            (SELECT 'Задание №' || st.task_number::text
             FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st WHERE st.id = wt.reference_id)
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = wt.user_id
        WHERE wt.type = 'work_payment'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('goods:' || pay.id::text),
            coalesce(pay.paid_at, pay.created_at),
            so.buyer_user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            'goods',
            'Чек за товары',
            pay.amount_rub,
            'Сделка №' || so.order_number::text
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_payments pay
        JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders so ON so.id = pay.order_id
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = so.buyer_user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = pay.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('memorial:' || pay.id::text),
            coalesce(pay.paid_at, pay.created_at),
            o.user_id,
            coalesce(u.full_name, o.buyer_name)::text,
            coalesce(u.email::text, o.buyer_email::text),
            'memorial',
            'Чек за QR-мемориал',
            pay.amount_rub,
            'Заказ №' || o.order_number::text
        FROM qr_commerce.payments pay
        JOIN qr_commerce.orders o ON o.id = pay.order_id
        LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = pay.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            ('other:' || wt.id::text),
            wt.created_at,
            wt.user_id,
            u.full_name::text,
            u.email::text,
            CASE wt.type WHEN 'listing_fee' THEN 'listing' ELSE 'package' END,
            CASE wt.type
                WHEN 'listing_fee' THEN 'Чек за размещение на витрине'
                ELSE 'Чек за доплату пакета'
            END,
            abs(wt.amount)::numeric,
            NULL
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = wt.user_id
        WHERE wt.type IN ('listing_fee', 'package_upgrade')
    ),
    filtered AS (
        SELECT * FROM slots s
        WHERE (p_user_id IS NULL OR s.user_id = p_user_id)
          AND (
                v_query IS NULL
                OR coalesce(s.user_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(s.user_email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(s.reference_label, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
              )
          AND (
                v_status IS NULL
                OR CASE
                    WHEN s.receipt_kind IN ('advance', 'goods', 'memorial') THEN 'sent'
                    ELSE 'not_sent'
                END = v_status
              )
    )
    SELECT
        f.slot_id,
        f.occurred_at,
        f.user_id,
        f.user_name,
        f.user_email,
        f.receipt_kind,
        f.title,
        f.amount_rub,
        f.reference_label,
        CASE
            WHEN f.receipt_kind IN ('advance', 'goods', 'memorial') THEN 'sent'
            ELSE 'not_sent'
        END,
        count(*) OVER ()
    FROM filtered f
    ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC
    LIMIT greatest(p_limit, 1)
    OFFSET greatest(p_offset, 0);
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_admin_list_task_finance(p_actor_user_id UUID, p_status_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_user_id UUID DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS UUID), p_query VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_limit INT DEFAULT 50, p_offset INT DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE (task_id UUID, task_number BIGINT, task_title TEXT, customer_user_id UUID, customer_name TEXT, plan_rub DECIMAL, received_rub DECIMAL, customer_fee_rub DECIMAL, executor_name TEXT, executor_user_id UUID, executor_fee_rub DECIMAL, paid_to_executor_rub DECIMAL, status_code TEXT, party_code TEXT, total_count BIGINT) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_status TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_status_code, '')), '');
    v_query TEXT := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_actor_user_id);
    IF v_status = 'all' THEN
        v_status := NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    WITH base AS (
        SELECT
            st.id AS task_id,
            st.task_number,
            st.title::text AS task_title,
            st.customer_user_id,
            cu.full_name::text AS customer_name,
            cu.email::text AS customer_email,
            CASE
                WHEN st.final_amount_rub IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE round(st.final_amount_rub) + round(st.final_amount_rub * 0.10)
            END AS plan_rub,
            coalesce((
                SELECT sum(abs(wt.amount))::numeric
                FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                WHERE wt.user_id = st.customer_user_id
                  AND wt.reference_id = st.id
                  AND wt.type IN ('work_payment', 'task_publish_fee')
            ), 0)
            - coalesce((
                SELECT sum(abs(wt.amount))::numeric
                FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                WHERE wt.user_id = st.customer_user_id
                  AND wt.reference_id = st.id
                  AND wt.type IN ('work_refund', 'task_cancel_refund')
            ), 0) AS received_rub,
            coalesce((
                SELECT sum(abs(wt.amount))::numeric
                FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                WHERE wt.reference_id = st.id AND wt.type = 'task_publish_fee'
            ), 0) AS customer_fee_rub,
            coalesce(c.short_name, c.legal_name)::text AS executor_name,
            cm.user_id AS executor_user_id,
            eu.full_name::text AS executor_user_name,
            eu.email::text AS executor_email,
            coalesce((
                SELECT sum(abs(wt.amount))::numeric
                FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                JOIN qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b ON b.id = wt.reference_id
                WHERE b.service_task_id = st.id AND wt.type = 'bid_fee'
            ), 0) AS executor_fee_rub,
            coalesce((
                SELECT ep.amount_rub
                FROM qr_marketplace.executor_payouts ep
                JOIN qr_ref.payout_statuses pst ON pst.id = ep.status_id
                WHERE ep.service_task_id = st.id AND pst.code = 'paid'
                LIMIT 1
            ), 0) AS paid_to_executor_rub,
            CASE
                WHEN sts.code = 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled'
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                    WHERE wt.reference_id = st.id
                      AND wt.type IN ('work_refund', 'task_cancel_refund')
                ) OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
                    JOIN qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b ON b.id = wt.reference_id
                    WHERE b.service_task_id = st.id AND wt.type = 'bid_refund'
                ) THEN 'refund'
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM qr_marketplace.executor_payouts ep
                    JOIN qr_ref.payout_statuses pst ON pst.id = ep.status_id
                    WHERE ep.service_task_id = st.id AND pst.code = 'paid'
                ) THEN 'succeeded'
                WHEN st.final_amount_rub IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending'
                ELSE 'open'
            END AS status_code
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        JOIN qr_identity.users cu ON cu.id = st.customer_user_id
        LEFT JOIN qr_marketplace.companies c ON c.id = st.assigned_company_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT cm.user_id
            FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
            WHERE cm.company_id = c.id
            ORDER BY cm.is_primary_contact DESC, cm.invited_at
            LIMIT 1
        ) cm ON TRUE
        LEFT JOIN qr_identity.users eu ON eu.id = cm.user_id
        WHERE sts.code <> 'draft'
    ),
    filtered AS (
        SELECT * FROM base b
        WHERE (p_user_id IS NULL OR b.customer_user_id = p_user_id OR b.executor_user_id = p_user_id)
          AND (
                v_query IS NULL
                OR coalesce(b.customer_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(b.customer_email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(b.executor_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(b.executor_user_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR coalesce(b.executor_email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_query || '%'
                OR b.task_number::text = v_query
              )
          AND (
                v_status IS NULL
                OR coalesce(
                    (SELECT mk.status_code FROM qr_commerce.admin_finance_task_marks mk WHERE mk.task_id = b.task_id),
                    b.status_code
                ) = v_status
          )
    )
    SELECT
        f.task_id,
        f.task_number,
        f.task_title,
        f.customer_user_id,
        f.customer_name,
        f.plan_rub,
        f.received_rub,
        f.customer_fee_rub,
        coalesce(f.executor_user_name, f.executor_name),
        f.executor_user_id,
        f.executor_fee_rub,
        f.paid_to_executor_rub,
        coalesce(
            (SELECT mk.status_code FROM qr_commerce.admin_finance_task_marks mk WHERE mk.task_id = f.task_id),
            f.status_code
        ),
        (SELECT mk.party_code FROM qr_commerce.admin_finance_task_marks mk WHERE mk.task_id = f.task_id),
        count(*) OVER ()
    FROM filtered f
    ORDER BY f.task_number DESC
    LIMIT greatest(p_limit, 1)
    OFFSET greatest(p_offset, 0);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_apply_package_upgrade(p_order_id UUID, p_target_pkg_id BIGINT, p_unit_price DECIMAL, p_max_photos INT, p_max_video_seconds INT, p_pkg_name VARCHAR, p_qr_code_id UUID DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS UUID)) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_memorial', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_line_id  UUID;
    v_qty      INT;
BEGIN
    IF p_qr_code_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q
            WHERE q.id = p_qr_code_id AND q.order_id = p_order_id
        ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'QR_NOT_IN_ORDER: %', p_qr_code_id
                USING ERRCODE = 'data_exception';
        END IF;

        UPDATE qr_commerce.qr_codes SET
            package_type_id = p_target_pkg_id,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = p_qr_code_id;

        UPDATE qr_memorial.memorials m SET
            package_type_id   = p_target_pkg_id,
            max_photos        = p_max_photos,
            max_video_seconds = p_max_video_seconds,
            updated_at        = now()
        FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q
        WHERE q.id = p_qr_code_id
          AND q.memorial_id = m.id
          AND m.deleted_at IS NULL;

        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT id, quantity INTO v_line_id, v_qty
    FROM qr_commerce.order_lines
    WHERE order_id = p_order_id
    LIMIT 1;

    IF v_line_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND: %', p_order_id
            USING ERRCODE = 'data_exception';
    END IF;

    UPDATE qr_commerce.order_lines SET
        package_type_id      = p_target_pkg_id,
        unit_price_rub       = p_unit_price,
        line_total_rub       = p_unit_price * v_qty,
        snapshot_max_photos   = p_max_photos,
        snapshot_max_video_sec = p_max_video_seconds,
        snapshot_package_name = p_pkg_name
    WHERE id = v_line_id;

    UPDATE qr_commerce.qr_codes SET
        package_type_id = p_target_pkg_id,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE order_id = p_order_id;

    UPDATE qr_memorial.memorials m SET
        package_type_id   = p_target_pkg_id,
        max_photos        = p_max_photos,
        max_video_seconds = p_max_video_seconds,
        updated_at        = now()
    FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q
    WHERE q.order_id = p_order_id
      AND q.memorial_id = m.id
      AND m.deleted_at IS NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_company_list_public(p_region_id BIGINT, p_city_id BIGINT, p_search TEXT, p_rating_kind VARCHAR, p_limit INT, p_offset INT) RETURNS TABLE (company_id UUID, display_name VARCHAR, description TEXT, logo_storage_key VARCHAR, avg_rating_tasks DECIMAL, review_count_tasks INT, avg_rating_products DECIMAL, review_count_products INT, product_count BIGINT, service_cities JSONB, total_count BIGINT) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    WITH base AS (
        SELECT c.id,
               coalesce(NULLIF(c.short_name, ''), c.legal_name) AS display_name,
               c.description,
               c.logo_storage_key,
               c.avg_rating_tasks,
               c.review_count_tasks,
               c.avg_rating_products,
               c.review_count_products
        FROM qr_marketplace.companies c
        JOIN qr_ref.company_verification_statuses vs ON vs.id = c.verification_status_id
        JOIN qr_ref.legal_entity_types let ON let.id = c.legal_entity_type_id
        WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND c.is_active = TRUE
          AND vs.code = 'verified'
          AND let.can_sell_products = TRUE
          AND (
              p_search IS NULL OR p_search = ''
              OR c.legal_name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
              OR coalesce(c.short_name, '') ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
          )
          AND (
              p_city_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.company_service_areas sa
                  WHERE sa.company_id = c.id AND sa.is_active AND sa.city_id = p_city_id
              )
          )
          AND (
              p_region_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.company_service_areas sa
                  JOIN qr_ref.cities ci ON ci.id = sa.city_id
                  WHERE sa.company_id = c.id AND sa.is_active AND ci.region_id = p_region_id
              )
          )
    )
    SELECT b.id AS company_id,
           b.display_name,
           b.description,
           b.logo_storage_key,
           b.avg_rating_tasks,
           b.review_count_tasks,
           b.avg_rating_products,
           b.review_count_products,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM qr_marketplace.company_products p
             WHERE p.company_id = b.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_active
               AND p.kind IN ('wreath', 'monument')) AS product_count,
           (
               SELECT coalesce(
                   jsonb_agg(
                       jsonb_build_object(
                           'city_id', ci.id,
                           'city_name', ci.name,
                           'region_name', r.name
                       )
                       ORDER BY r.name, ci.name
                   ),
                   '[]'::jsonb
               )
               FROM qr_marketplace.company_service_areas sa
               JOIN qr_ref.cities ci ON ci.id = sa.city_id
               JOIN qr_ref.regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
               WHERE sa.company_id = b.id AND sa.is_active AND sa.city_id IS NOT NULL
           ) AS service_cities,
           count(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM base b
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN coalesce(p_rating_kind, 'tasks') = 'products'
             THEN b.avg_rating_products ELSE b.avg_rating_tasks END DESC,
        b.display_name ASC
    LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_company_review_for_entity(p_user_id UUID, p_kind VARCHAR, p_entity_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (eligible BOOLEAN, already_exists BOOLEAN, name_required BOOLEAN, review_id UUID, rating SMALLINT, body TEXT, author_name VARCHAR, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_kind VARCHAR;
    v_name TEXT;
    v_ok BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_rev qr_marketplace.company_reviews%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    v_kind := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_kind, '')));
    SELECT nullif(btrim(coalesce(full_name, '')), '') INTO v_name
    FROM qr_identity.users WHERE id = p_user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_kind = 'task' THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
            JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
            WHERE st.id = p_entity_id
              AND st.customer_user_id = p_user_id
              AND st.assigned_company_id IS NOT NULL
              AND sts.code = 'completed'
        ) INTO v_ok;
        SELECT * INTO v_rev
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_reviews r
        WHERE r.service_task_id = p_entity_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        LIMIT 1;
    ELSIF v_kind = 'product' THEN
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders o
            JOIN qr_ref.order_statuses os ON os.id = o.status_id
            JOIN qr_ref.fulfillment_statuses fs ON fs.id = o.fulfillment_status_id
            WHERE o.id = p_entity_id
              AND o.buyer_user_id = p_user_id
              AND os.code = 'fulfilled'
              AND fs.code = 'completed'
        ) INTO v_ok;
        SELECT * INTO v_rev
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_reviews r
        WHERE r.shop_order_id = p_entity_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
        LIMIT 1;
    ELSE
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INVALID_KIND';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        (v_ok AND v_rev.id IS NULL AND v_name IS NOT NULL) AS eligible,
        (v_rev.id IS NOT NULL) AS already_exists,
        (v_ok AND v_rev.id IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL) AS name_required,
        v_rev.id,
        v_rev.rating,
        v_rev.body,
        v_rev.author_name,
        v_rev.created_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_notification_log_upsert(p_notification_type_id BIGINT, p_order_id UUID, p_service_task_id UUID, p_user_id UUID, p_recipient_email VARCHAR, p_subject VARCHAR, p_external_message_id VARCHAR, p_error_message TEXT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS TEXT)) RETURNS UUID LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_id UUID;
BEGIN
    IF p_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT nl.id INTO v_id
        FROM qr_platform.notification_log nl
        WHERE nl.order_id = p_order_id AND nl.notification_type_id = p_notification_type_id
        LIMIT 1;
    ELSIF p_service_task_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT nl.id INTO v_id
        FROM qr_platform.notification_log nl
        WHERE nl.service_task_id = p_service_task_id AND nl.notification_type_id = p_notification_type_id
        LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        IF p_error_message IS NULL THEN
            UPDATE qr_platform.notification_log SET
                recipient_email = lower(p_recipient_email),
                subject = p_subject,
                external_message_id = p_external_message_id,
                sent_at = now(),
                failed_at = NULL,
                error_message = NULL
            WHERE id = v_id;
        ELSE
            UPDATE qr_platform.notification_log SET
                recipient_email = lower(p_recipient_email),
                subject = p_subject,
                external_message_id = p_external_message_id,
                failed_at = now(),
                error_message = p_error_message
            WHERE id = v_id;
        END IF;
        RETURN v_id;
    END IF;

    v_id := uuidv7();
    INSERT INTO qr_platform.notification_log (
        id, notification_type_id, order_id, service_task_id, user_id, recipient_email,
        subject, external_message_id, sent_at, failed_at, error_message
    ) VALUES (
        v_id, p_notification_type_id, p_order_id, p_service_task_id, p_user_id,
        lower(p_recipient_email), p_subject, p_external_message_id,
        CASE WHEN p_error_message IS NULL THEN now() ELSE now() END,
        CASE WHEN p_error_message IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE now() END,
        p_error_message
    );
    RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_resolve_qr_by_slug(p_slug VARCHAR) RETURNS TABLE (code_slug VARCHAR, memorial_id UUID, resolve_status VARCHAR) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT
        q.code_slug,
        q.memorial_id,
        CASE
            WHEN q.memorial_id IS NULL THEN 'pending_memorial'
            WHEN m.id IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.is_published THEN 'ready'
            ELSE 'pending_memorial'
        END AS resolve_status
    FROM qr_commerce.qr_codes q
    LEFT JOIN qr_memorial.memorials m ON m.id = q.memorial_id
    WHERE q.code_slug = p_slug
    LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_search_cities(p_query VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_region_id BIGINT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), p_limit INT DEFAULT 20) RETURNS TABLE (id BIGINT, name VARCHAR, region_name VARCHAR, region_id BIGINT) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT c.id, c.name, r.name, r.id
    FROM qr_ref.cities c
    JOIN qr_ref.regions r ON r.id = c.region_id
    WHERE (p_region_id IS NULL OR c.region_id = p_region_id)
      AND (
          p_query IS NULL
          OR length(trim(p_query)) = 0
          OR c.name ILIKE '%' || trim(p_query) || '%'
          OR r.name ILIKE '%' || trim(p_query) || '%'
      )
    ORDER BY
        CASE
            WHEN p_query IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p_query)) > 0
                 AND c.name ILIKE trim(p_query) || '%' THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END,
        c.name
    LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 50));
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_admin_get_dispute_evidence(p_task_id UUID, p_admin_user_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (verifier_id UUID, invite_name VARCHAR, invite_email citext, status_code VARCHAR, comment TEXT, responded_at TIMESTAMPTZ, attachments JSONB) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    PERFORM qr_api.sp_admin_assert_actor(p_admin_user_id);
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        WHERE st.id = p_task_id AND sts.code = 'disputed'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_DISPUTED';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        v.id,
        v.invite_name,
        v.invite_email,
        tvs.code,
        v.comment,
        v.responded_at,
        coalesce((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', a.id,
                    'storage_key', a.storage_key,
                    'mime_type', a.mime_type,
                    'size_bytes', a.size_bytes,
                    'original_filename', a.original_filename
                ) ORDER BY a.created_at
            )
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_verifier_attachments a
            WHERE a.verifier_id = v.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_verifiers v
    JOIN qr_ref.task_verifier_statuses tvs ON tvs.id = v.status_id
    WHERE v.service_task_id = p_task_id
    ORDER BY v.invited_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_count_published(p_region_ids BIGINT[] DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT[]), p_city_ids BIGINT[] DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT[]), p_category_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_bids_min INT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS INT), p_bids_max INT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS INT)) RETURNS BIGINT LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    WITH active_bids AS (
        SELECT b.service_task_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS cnt
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b
        JOIN qr_ref.bid_statuses bs ON bs.id = b.status_id
        WHERE bs.code = 'submitted'
        GROUP BY b.service_task_id
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
    JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cemeteries cem ON cem.id = st.cemetery_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cities ci ON ci.id = cem.city_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
    LEFT JOIN active_bids ab ON ab.service_task_id = st.id
    WHERE sts.code = 'published'
      AND (p_region_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_region_ids) = 0 OR r.id = ANY(p_region_ids))
      AND (p_city_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_city_ids) = 0 OR ci.id = ANY(p_city_ids))
      AND (p_category_code IS NULL OR sc.code = p_category_code)
      AND (p_bids_min IS NULL OR COALESCE(ab.cnt, 0) >= p_bids_min)
      AND (p_bids_max IS NULL OR COALESCE(ab.cnt, 0) <= p_bids_max);
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_get(p_task_id UUID, p_user_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, task_number BIGINT, customer_user_id UUID, title VARCHAR, description TEXT, category_code VARCHAR, category_name VARCHAR, status_code VARCHAR, status_name VARCHAR, desired_amount_rub DECIMAL, final_amount_rub DECIMAL, platform_fee_rub DECIMAL, grave_latitude DECIMAL, grave_longitude DECIMAL, grave_location_label VARCHAR, cemetery_id INT, cemetery_name VARCHAR, memorial_id UUID, preferred_company_id UUID, assigned_company_id UUID, assigned_company_name VARCHAR, assigned_bid_id UUID, assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ, verification_deadline_at TIMESTAMPTZ, completed_by_executor_at TIMESTAMPTZ, verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ, cancel_reason TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, published_at TIMESTAMPTZ, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, desired_completion_at DATE, attributes JSONB, executor_fee_paid_at TIMESTAMPTZ, customer_work_paid BOOLEAN, executor_payout_status_code VARCHAR) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT st.id, st.task_number, st.customer_user_id, st.title, st.description,
        sc.code, sc.name, sts.code, sts.name,
        st.desired_amount_rub, st.final_amount_rub, st.platform_fee_rub,
        st.grave_latitude, st.grave_longitude,
        CASE WHEN qr_api.sp_service_task_user_can_view_private_details(p_task_id, p_user_id)
            THEN st.grave_location_label ELSE NULL END,
        st.cemetery_id, cem.name, st.memorial_id, st.preferred_company_id,
        st.assigned_company_id, coalesce(ac.short_name, ac.legal_name),
        st.assigned_bid_id, st.assigned_at,
        st.verification_deadline_at, st.completed_by_executor_at, st.verified_at,
        st.cancel_reason, st.created_at, st.published_at, st.updated_at,
        st.desired_completion_at, coalesce(st.attributes, '{}'::jsonb),
        st.executor_fee_paid_at,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments p
            JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
            WHERE p.service_task_id = st.id AND ps.code = 'succeeded'
        ) AS customer_work_paid,
        (
            SELECT pst.code
            FROM qr_marketplace.executor_payouts ep
            JOIN qr_ref.payout_statuses pst ON pst.id = ep.status_id
            WHERE ep.service_task_id = st.id
        ) AS executor_payout_status_code
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
    JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cemeteries cem ON cem.id = st.cemetery_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_marketplace.companies ac ON ac.id = st.assigned_company_id
    WHERE st.id = p_task_id
      AND qr_api.sp_service_task_user_can_view(p_task_id, p_user_id);
$function$

    SELECT st.id, st.task_number, st.title, sc.code, sc.name, sts.code, sts.name,
        st.desired_amount_rub, cem.name, ci.name, st.published_at, st.created_at
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
    JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cemeteries cem ON cem.id = st.cemetery_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cities ci ON ci.id = cem.city_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_list_bid_offers(p_task_id UUID, p_actor_user_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, bid_id UUID, amount_rub DECIMAL, offered_by_role VARCHAR, offered_by_user_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    v_owner UUID;
    v_is_admin BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    SELECT st.customer_user_id INTO v_owner FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st WHERE st.id = p_task_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'no_data_found';
    END IF;

    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM qr_identity.users u
        JOIN qr_ref.user_roles ur ON ur.id = u.role_id
        WHERE u.id = p_actor_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND ur.code = 'admin'
    ) INTO v_is_admin;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        o.id,
        o.bid_id,
        o.amount_rub,
        o.offered_by_role,
        o.offered_by_user_id,
        o.created_at
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bid_offers o
    JOIN qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b ON b.id = o.bid_id
    WHERE b.service_task_id = p_task_id
      AND (
          v_owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_actor_user_id
          OR coalesce(v_is_admin, FALSE)
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
              WHERE cm.company_id = b.company_id AND cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id
          )
      )
      AND (
          -- исполнитель видит только свой отклик
          v_owner IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_actor_user_id
          OR coalesce(v_is_admin, FALSE)
          OR EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
              WHERE cm.company_id = b.company_id AND cm.user_id = p_actor_user_id
          )
      )
    ORDER BY o.created_at ASC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_list_bids(p_task_id UUID, p_actor_user_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, company_id UUID, company_name VARCHAR, avg_rating_tasks DECIMAL, review_count_tasks INT, status_code VARCHAR, status_name VARCHAR, proposed_amount_rub DECIMAL, message TEXT, created_by_user_id UUID, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, customer_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, executor_accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE
    v_owner UUID;
    v_is_admin BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    SELECT st.customer_user_id INTO v_owner FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st WHERE st.id = p_task_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE = 'no_data_found';
    END IF;

    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM qr_identity.users u
        JOIN qr_ref.user_roles ur ON ur.id = u.role_id
        WHERE u.id = p_actor_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND ur.code = 'admin'
    ) INTO v_is_admin;

    IF v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor_user_id AND NOT coalesce(v_is_admin, FALSE) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        b.id,
        b.company_id,
        coalesce(c.short_name, c.legal_name),
        c.avg_rating_tasks,
        c.review_count_tasks,
        bs.code,

        b.executor_accepted_at
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b
    JOIN qr_ref.bid_statuses bs ON bs.id = b.status_id
    JOIN qr_marketplace.companies c ON c.id = b.company_id
    WHERE b.service_task_id = p_task_id

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_list_messages(p_task_id UUID, p_user_id UUID, p_after TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, sender_user_id UUID, sender_name VARCHAR, is_customer BOOLEAN, body TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, read_at TIMESTAMPTZ, attachments JSONB) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NOT qr_api.sp_service_task_user_can_view_private_details(p_task_id, p_user_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN';
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        WHERE st.id = p_task_id AND sts.code = 'awaiting_payment'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHAT_LOCKED' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
        m.id,
        m.sender_user_id,
        coalesce(u.full_name, u.email::VARCHAR, 'Участник')::VARCHAR AS sender_name,
        (m.sender_user_id = st.customer_user_id) AS is_customer,
        m.body,
        m.created_at,
        m.read_at,
        coalesce((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', a.id,
                    'storage_key', a.storage_key,
                    'mime_type', a.mime_type,
                    'size_bytes', a.size_bytes,
                    'original_filename', a.original_filename
                ) ORDER BY a.created_at
            )
            FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_message_attachments a
            WHERE a.message_id = m.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb) AS attachments
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_messages m
    JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = m.service_task_id
    JOIN qr_identity.users u ON u.id = m.sender_user_id
    WHERE m.service_task_id = p_task_id
      AND (p_after IS NULL OR m.created_at > p_after)
    ORDER BY m.created_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_list_published(p_limit INT DEFAULT 20, p_offset INT DEFAULT 0, p_region_ids BIGINT[] DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT[]), p_city_ids BIGINT[] DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS BIGINT[]), p_category_code VARCHAR DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), p_bids_min INT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS INT), p_bids_max INT DEFAULT CAST(NULL AS INT)) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, task_number BIGINT, title VARCHAR, description TEXT, category_code VARCHAR, category_name VARCHAR, status_code VARCHAR, status_name VARCHAR, desired_amount_rub DECIMAL, grave_location_label VARCHAR, cemetery_name VARCHAR, city_name VARCHAR, city_id BIGINT, region_id BIGINT, region_name VARCHAR, bids_count INT, published_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    WITH active_bids AS (
        SELECT b.service_task_id, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS cnt
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b
        JOIN qr_ref.bid_statuses bs ON bs.id = b.status_id
        WHERE bs.code = 'submitted'
        GROUP BY b.service_task_id
    )
    SELECT
        st.id,
        st.task_number,
        st.title,
        st.description,
        sc.code,
        sc.name,
        sts.code,
        sts.name,
        st.desired_amount_rub,
        NULL::VARCHAR,
        cem.name,
        ci.name,
        ci.id,
        r.id,
        r.name,
        COALESCE(ab.cnt, 0),
        st.published_at,
        st.created_at
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_ref.service_categories sc ON sc.id = st.category_id
    JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cemeteries cem ON cem.id = st.cemetery_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.cities ci ON ci.id = cem.city_id
    LEFT JOIN qr_ref.regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id
    LEFT JOIN active_bids ab ON ab.service_task_id = st.id
    WHERE sts.code = 'published'
      AND (p_region_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_region_ids) = 0 OR r.id = ANY(p_region_ids))
      AND (p_city_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_city_ids) = 0 OR ci.id = ANY(p_city_ids))
      AND (p_category_code IS NULL OR sc.code = p_category_code)
      AND (p_bids_min IS NULL OR COALESCE(ab.cnt, 0) >= p_bids_min)
      AND (p_bids_max IS NULL OR COALESCE(ab.cnt, 0) <= p_bids_max)
    ORDER BY st.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, st.created_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_message_recipients(p_task_id UUID, p_sender_user_id UUID) RETURNS TABLE (user_id UUID) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
    -- Заказчик написал → участники компании-исполнителя.
    SELECT cm.user_id
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_marketplace.company_members cm ON cm.company_id = st.assigned_company_id
    WHERE st.id = p_task_id
      AND st.customer_user_id = p_sender_user_id
      AND cm.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sender_user_id
    UNION
    -- Исполнитель написал → заказчик.
    SELECT st.customer_user_id
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    WHERE st.id = p_task_id
      AND st.customer_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sender_user_id
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM qr_marketplace.company_members cm
          WHERE cm.company_id = st.assigned_company_id AND cm.user_id = p_sender_user_id
      )
    UNION
    -- Администратор написал → заказчик.
    SELECT st.customer_user_id
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    WHERE st.id = p_task_id
      AND st.customer_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sender_user_id
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM qr_identity.users u
          JOIN qr_ref.user_roles r ON r.id = u.role_id
          WHERE u.id = p_sender_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.code = 'admin'
      )
    UNION
    -- Администратор написал → участники компании-исполнителя.
    SELECT cm.user_id
    FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
    JOIN qr_marketplace.company_members cm ON cm.company_id = st.assigned_company_id
    WHERE st.id = p_task_id
      AND cm.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sender_user_id
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM qr_identity.users u
          JOIN qr_ref.user_roles r ON r.id = u.role_id
          WHERE u.id = p_sender_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.code = 'admin'
      )
    UNION
    -- Заказчик или исполнитель написали → все активные админы (кроме отправителя).
    SELECT u.id
    FROM qr_identity.users u
    JOIN qr_ref.user_roles r ON r.id = u.role_id
    WHERE r.code = 'admin'
      AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND u.is_active
      AND u.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sender_user_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM qr_identity.users su
          JOIN qr_ref.user_roles sr ON sr.id = su.role_id
          WHERE su.id = p_sender_user_id AND su.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.code = 'admin'
      );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_service_task_payment_timeout() RETURNS INT LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_task RECORD;
    v_cancelled BIGINT;
    v_count INTEGER := 0;
    v_publish_fee INTEGER;
    v_bid_fee INTEGER;
    v_executor_user_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT qr_api.sp_lookup_service_task_status_id('cancelled') INTO v_cancelled;

    FOR v_task IN
        SELECT st.id, st.customer_user_id, st.assigned_bid_id, st.task_number, st.title
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_tasks st
        JOIN qr_ref.service_task_statuses sts ON sts.id = st.status_id
        WHERE sts.code = 'awaiting_payment'
          AND st.payment_deadline_at IS NOT NULL
          AND st.payment_deadline_at < now()
        FOR UPDATE OF st
    LOOP
        UPDATE qr_marketplace.service_tasks
        SET status_id = v_cancelled, cancelled_at = now(), cancel_reason = 'payment_timeout'
        WHERE id = v_task.id;

        PERFORM qr_api.sp_service_task_log_status(
            v_task.id,
            qr_api.sp_lookup_service_task_status_id('awaiting_payment'),
            v_cancelled,
            NULL,
            'payment_timeout'
        );

        SELECT abs(wt.amount) INTO v_publish_fee
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        WHERE wt.reference_type = 'service_task'
          AND wt.reference_id = v_task.id
          AND wt.type = 'task_publish_fee'
        LIMIT 1;

        IF v_publish_fee IS NOT NULL AND v_publish_fee > 0 THEN
            PERFORM qr_api.sp_wallet_credit(
                v_task.customer_user_id,
                v_publish_fee,
                'task_cancel_refund',
                'service_task',
                v_task.id,
                format('Возврат комиссии (таймаут оплаты, задание «%s»)', v_task.title),
                uuidv7()
            );
        END IF;

        IF v_task.assigned_bid_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            SELECT abs(wt.amount), cm.user_id
            INTO v_bid_fee, v_executor_user_id
            FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
            JOIN qr_marketplace.service_task_bids b ON b.id = wt.reference_id
            JOIN qr_marketplace.company_members cm ON cm.company_id = b.company_id
            WHERE wt.reference_type = 'bid'
              AND wt.type = 'bid_fee'
              AND b.id = v_task.assigned_bid_id
            ORDER BY cm.is_primary_contact DESC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1;

            IF v_bid_fee IS NOT NULL AND v_bid_fee > 0 AND v_executor_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                PERFORM qr_api.sp_wallet_credit(
                    v_executor_user_id,
                    v_bid_fee,
                    'bid_refund',
                    'bid',
                    v_task.assigned_bid_id,
                    format('Возврат комиссии за отклик (таймаут, задание «%s»)', v_task.title),
                    uuidv7()
                );
            END IF;
        END IF;

        PERFORM qr_api.sp_user_notification_create(
            v_task.customer_user_id,
            'task_cancelled',
            'Время оплаты истекло',
            format('Задание №%s отменено — оплата не поступила в срок', v_task.task_number),
            'service_task',
            v_task.id,
            '/tasks/' || v_task.id::TEXT
        );

        v_count := v_count + 1;
    END LOOP;

    RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

BEGIN

    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.user_id,
        coalesce(u.full_name, u.email::VARCHAR, 'Пользователь')::VARCHAR,
        u.email::VARCHAR,
        c.status_code,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_update_memorial(p_id UUID, p_actor_user_id UUID, p_is_admin BOOLEAN, p_set_full_name BOOLEAN, p_full_name VARCHAR, p_set_birth_date BOOLEAN, p_birth_date DATE, p_set_death_date BOOLEAN, p_death_date DATE, p_set_father_name BOOLEAN, p_father_name VARCHAR, p_set_mother_name BOOLEAN, p_mother_name VARCHAR, p_set_epitaph BOOLEAN, p_epitaph VARCHAR, p_set_grave_address BOOLEAN, p_grave_address VARCHAR, p_set_grave_lat BOOLEAN, p_grave_lat DECIMAL, p_set_grave_lng BOOLEAN, p_grave_lng DECIMAL, p_set_grave_placement_hint BOOLEAN, p_grave_placement_hint TEXT, p_set_is_published BOOLEAN, p_is_published BOOLEAN, p_lock_profile BOOLEAN) RETURNS BOOLEAN LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_owner UUID;
    v_locked TIMESTAMPTZ;
    v_full_name VARCHAR(256);
    v_birth_date DATE;
    v_death_date DATE;
    v_father_name VARCHAR(256);
    v_mother_name VARCHAR(256);
BEGIN
    SELECT
        owner_user_id,
        profile_locked_at,
        deceased_full_name,
        birth_date,
        death_date,
        father_full_name,
        mother_full_name
    INTO
        v_owner,
        v_locked,
        v_full_name,
        v_birth_date,
        v_death_date,
        v_father_name,
        v_mother_name
    FROM qr_memorial.memorials
    WHERE id = p_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;

    IF v_owner IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'MEMORIAL_NOT_FOUND'
            USING ERRCODE = 'no_data_found';
    END IF;

    IF v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor_user_id AND NOT p_is_admin THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FORBIDDEN'
            USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
    END IF;

    -- Блокируем только реальное изменение ФИО/дат; повторное сохранение тех же значений — ок
    -- (эпитафия, могила, публикация, медиа этой блокировкой не затрагиваются).
    IF v_locked IS NOT NULL AND (
        (p_set_full_name AND p_full_name IS DISTINCT FROM v_full_name) OR
        (p_set_birth_date AND p_birth_date IS DISTINCT FROM v_birth_date) OR
        (p_set_death_date AND p_death_date IS DISTINCT FROM v_death_date) OR
        (p_set_father_name AND p_father_name IS DISTINCT FROM v_father_name) OR
        (p_set_mother_name AND p_mother_name IS DISTINCT FROM v_mother_name)
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'PROFILE_LOCKED'
            USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
    END IF;

    UPDATE qr_memorial.memorials m
    SET
        deceased_full_name = CASE WHEN p_set_full_name THEN p_full_name ELSE m.deceased_full_name END,
        birth_date = CASE WHEN p_set_birth_date THEN p_birth_date ELSE m.birth_date END,
        death_date = CASE WHEN p_set_death_date THEN p_death_date ELSE m.death_date END,
        father_full_name = CASE WHEN p_set_father_name THEN p_father_name ELSE m.father_full_name END,
        mother_full_name = CASE WHEN p_set_mother_name THEN p_mother_name ELSE m.mother_full_name END,
        epitaph = CASE WHEN p_set_epitaph THEN p_epitaph ELSE m.epitaph END,
        grave_location_label = CASE WHEN p_set_grave_address THEN p_grave_address ELSE m.grave_location_label END,
        grave_placement_hint = CASE WHEN p_set_grave_placement_hint THEN p_grave_placement_hint ELSE m.grave_placement_hint END,
        grave_latitude = CASE WHEN p_set_grave_lat THEN p_grave_lat ELSE m.grave_latitude END,
        grave_longitude = CASE WHEN p_set_grave_lng THEN p_grave_lng ELSE m.grave_longitude END,
        is_published = CASE WHEN p_set_is_published THEN p_is_published ELSE m.is_published END,
        profile_locked_at = CASE
            WHEN coalesce(p_lock_profile, FALSE) AND m.profile_locked_at IS NULL THEN now()
            ELSE m.profile_locked_at
        END,
        published_at = CASE
            WHEN p_set_is_published AND p_is_published THEN coalesce(m.published_at, now())
            ELSE m.published_at
        END
    WHERE m.id = p_id;

    RETURN TRUE;
END;
$function$
