CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION qr_api.sp_wallet_get_history(p_user_id UUID, p_limit INT DEFAULT 20, p_offset INT DEFAULT 0) RETURNS TABLE (id UUID, type TEXT, amount INT, balance_after INT, reference_type TEXT, reference_id UUID, description TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, display_id TEXT, affects_balance BOOLEAN, total_count BIGINT) LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'qr_api', 'qr_marketplace', 'qr_memorial', 'qr_commerce', 'qr_identity', 'qr_ref', 'qr_platform', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH wallet_rows AS (
        SELECT
            wt.id,
            wt.type,
            wt.amount,
            wt.balance_after,
            wt.reference_type,
            wt.reference_id,
            wt.description,
            wt.created_at,
            CASE
                WHEN wt.type = 'top_up' THEN 'D'
                WHEN wt.type IN ('task_cancel_refund', 'bid_refund', 'work_refund', 'admin_refund', 'shop_refund') THEN 'R'
                ELSE 'S'
            END AS prefix,
            TRUE AS affects_balance
        FROM qr_commerce.wallet_transactions wt
        WHERE wt.user_id = p_user_id
    ),
    card_rows AS (
        SELECT
            p.id,
            'card_qr' AS type,
            (-round(p.amount_rub))::INTEGER AS amount,
            NULL::INTEGER AS balance_after,
            'order' AS reference_type,
            o.id AS reference_id,
            format(
                'Покупка QR «%s» × %s, заказ №%s (карта)',
                coalesce(ol.snapshot_package_name, 'пакет'),
                coalesce(ol.quantity, 1),
                o.order_number
            ) AS description,
            coalesce(p.paid_at, p.created_at) AS created_at,
            'C' AS prefix,
            FALSE AS affects_balance
        FROM qr_commerce.payments p
        JOIN qr_commerce.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        LEFT JOIN qr_commerce.order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND coalesce(o.created_by_user_id, o.user_id) = p_user_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            p.id,
            'card_shop',
            (-round(p.amount_rub))::INTEGER,
            NULL::INTEGER,
            'shop_order',
            o.id,
            format('Покупка товара, заказ №%s (карта)', o.order_number),
            coalesce(p.paid_at, p.created_at),
            'C',
            FALSE
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_shop_order_payments p
        JOIN qr_marketplace.company_shop_orders o ON o.id = p.order_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND o.buyer_user_id = p_user_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            p.id,
            'card_task',
            (-round(p.amount_rub))::INTEGER,
            NULL::INTEGER,
            'service_task',
            st.id,
            format('Оплата работы по заданию «%s» №%s (карта)', st.title, st.task_number),
            coalesce(p.paid_at, p.created_at),
            'C',
            FALSE
        FROM qr_marketplace.service_task_payments p
        JOIN qr_marketplace.service_tasks st ON st.id = p.service_task_id
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND st.customer_user_id = p_user_id

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            lp.id,
            'card_listing',
            (-round(lp.amount_rub))::INTEGER,
            NULL::INTEGER,
            'listing',
            lp.id,
            format('Размещение %s товар(ов) на витрине (карта)', lp.product_count),
            coalesce(lp.paid_at, lp.created_at),
            'C',
            FALSE
        FROM qr_marketplace.company_product_listing_payments lp
        JOIN qr_ref.payment_statuses ps ON ps.id = lp.status_id
        WHERE ps.code = 'succeeded'
          AND lp.paid_by_user_id = p_user_id
    ),
    all_rows AS (
        SELECT * FROM wallet_rows
        UNION ALL
        SELECT * FROM card_rows
    ),
    numbered AS (
        SELECT
            r.*,
            (r.prefix || '-' || row_number() OVER (
                PARTITION BY r.prefix ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
            )::TEXT) AS display_id
        FROM all_rows r
    )
    SELECT
        n.id,
        n.type,
        n.amount,
        n.balance_after,
        n.reference_type,
        n.reference_id,
        n.description,
        n.created_at,
        n.display_id,
        n.affects_balance,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM numbered n
    ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
    LIMIT greatest(p_limit, 1)
    OFFSET greatest(p_offset, 0);
END;
$function$
